builds.label: Official Docker image
builds.builtBy: Docker Official Images. The docker-library team maintains the Dockerfiles; Docker builds them.
builds.channel: Docker Hub, tag php:8.5-cli (also 8.5.12-cli-trixie), one image for each of 8 architectures. Pull a new image to update.

builds.label: Official Docker image (Alpine)
builds.builtBy: Docker Official Images. The docker-library team maintains the Dockerfiles; Docker builds them.
builds.channel: Docker Hub, tag php:8.5-cli-alpine (also 8.5.12-cli-alpine3.24), one image for each of 8 architectures. Pull a new image to update.

builds.label: Debian 13 + packages.sury.org
builds.install:
# after adding packages.sury.org, see the repository link above
apt install php8.5-{cli,curl,mbstring,xml,intl,gd,zip,mysql,pgsql,sqlite3,bcmath,readline}
builds.builtBy: Ondřej Surý, who also maintains PHP in Debian itself. The packaging matches Debian's.
builds.channel: packages.sury.org through apt, signed with his own key. You trust that key, not Debian.

builds.label: Ubuntu 26.04
builds.builtBy: Canonical, from Debian's packaging, compiled on Launchpad.
builds.channel: The Ubuntu archive through apt, component main, in resolute-security and resolute-updates.

builds.label: Alpine 3.24
builds.install: apk add php85 $(printf 'php85-%s ' curl mbstring xml dom simplexml xmlreader xmlwriter intl gd zip mysqli pdo pdo_mysql pgsql pdo_pgsql pdo_sqlite sqlite3 bcmath ctype fileinfo tokenizer session iconv openssl phar sodium)
builds.builtBy: Alpine Linux, from the php85 recipe in aports, compiled on Alpine's build servers.
builds.channel: Alpine mirrors through apk, from the community repository.

builds.label: Fedora 44
builds.builtBy: The Fedora php package maintainers, compiled on Koji, the Fedora build system.
builds.channel: Fedora mirrors through dnf, from the updates repository.

docker-debian.about: Built from the php.net source on Debian 13 and installed to /usr/local. It uses the copies bundled in php-src. Debian packages provide the libraries under it, so apt updates those, while PHP itself changes only with a new image.

docker-alpine.about: The same build recipe as the Debian image, on Alpine 3.24 with musl libc. It uses the copies bundled in php-src.

packages.name: tzdata
packages.note: Read by PHP instead of its bundled copy

debian-13-sury.about: Debian 13 itself ships PHP 8.4; this third-party repository is the common way to get 8.5 on it. It uses the system PCRE2, libgd and time zone database instead of the copies bundled in php-src.

packages.name: tzdata
packages.note: Read by PHP instead of its bundled copy

ubuntu-26.04.about: Ubuntu 26.04 stays on PHP 8.5.4 and backports security fixes into it, so the package revision tells you more than the PHP version. It uses the system PCRE2, libgd and time zone database instead of the copies bundled in php-src.

alpine-3.24.about: Alpine's php85 packages, built against musl libc. It uses the system PCRE2 instead of the copy bundled in php-src.

packages.name: tzdata
packages.note: Read by PHP instead of its bundled copy

fedora-44.about: Fedora's own php packages, updated to each PHP patch release. It uses the system PCRE2, libgd, uriparser and time zone database instead of the copies bundled in php-src.
